# Deliverable File Links

- Whenever delivering a generated or revised artifact, or answering where it is,
  lead with a clickable Markdown link to the actual primary output file.
- Use the workspace-relative file path as both the visible link text and target
  (encode spaces in the target). Verify that the file exists before linking it.
  Do not substitute a directory, a manifest, a plain filename, or instructions to
  find the file in Explorer for the primary file link.
- For video deliveries, always link the MP4 first, followed by the caption file
  and production manifest. Clearly identify previews and missing narration.
- Local file references are not hosted playback URLs. Never invent a localhost
  or download URL, start a server, or upload an artifact merely to supply a link;
  obtain any required operational approval separately.
